title: BETHEL: Where Jacob Met God
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel at the ancient site of Bethel, modern-day Beitin. In Genesis 28, the Bible tells the story of Jacob dreaming about a stairway coming down from heaven with angels ascending and descending. What is the significance of that dream? Watch to find out!

title: The Discovery of Joshua's Great Witness Stone at Shechem
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel at the ruins of ancient Shechem, where Joshua, after renewing the covenant with Israel, erected “a large stone and set it up under the oak near the holy place of the LORD.” (Joshua 9:26) Listen to the story of how this very stone was found…and almost lost…through archaeology.

title: The Problem of Joshua's Ai...SOLVED!
author: Expedition Bible
description: The Battle of Ai is a pivotal story in the Bible and has traditionally been understood to have occurred at the ancient site called Et Tell. In modern times, however, archaeology has identified what it calls "The Problem of Ai," claiming that the pottery timeline at Et Tell doesn't match the Bible's timeline, casting doubt on whether the story is true or not. Watch today's video to understand why the details in the Bible easily line up with the archaeology of the site. "The Problem of Ai" is no problem at all!

title: The Last Supper and Pentecost...HERE!
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel in learning how the Upper Room was found and identified, and marvel with him that we can still visit this site where Jesus shared his last supper with his disciples and instructed them to wait for the Day of Pentecost.

title: Where Jesus Was Crucified: The archaeological evidence!
author: Expedition Bible
description: The Bible tells us that Jesus was crucified outside of the city walls of Jerusalem, at Golgotha, "the place of the skull." Christians who lived in Jerusalem after his death knew exactly where that place was. But today, can we know with certainty the spot where Jesus was crucified? What does archaeology tell us?

title: Jesus' Tomb Explained--the evidence & the story!
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel as he travels from Israel to Rome to Turkey, to explain the evidence for and tell the story of the first and most important archaeological dig ever conducted...the excavation of the Tomb of Jesus.

title: PENIEL: Where Jacob saw the Face of God and lived!
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel as he explores the ancient site which Jacob named Peniel. Located in the modern-day country of Jordan, this Biblical site is the very location where Jacob, in fear for his life, cried out to be saved and found himself in a wrestling match with God!

title: Search for the Tower of Babel
author: Expedition Bible
description: Join Joel as he explores the ancient site which Jacob named Peniel. Located in the modern-day country of Jordan, this Biblical site is the very location where Jacob, in fear for his life, cried out to be saved and found himself in a wrestling match with God!

title: Archaeology and the Resurrection of Lazarus
author: Expedition Bible
description: Does archaeology support the traditional site of Lazarus' Tomb, where Jesus performed one of his most important miracles...the resurrection of Lazarus from the dead?

title: Archaeology of Jacob's Well at Shechem
author: Expedition Bible
description: If there is one place where we can know for certain that Jesus was right there, it is at Jacob's Well. How can we know? In the Gospel of John, chapter 4 provides key details needed to be able to trace the archaeology to anchor that well as the very place where Jesus offered the Samaritan woman "living water."
